intent: Independently verify calibration-harness fidelity and failure handling before executing the frozen instruction-boundary comparison.
scope: Harness readiness only. No model calibration outcome or candidate acceptance is established.
verified_fidelity: Both conditions enumerate the same eleven frozen fixtures, including context_override for the eligibility/realization boundary.
The sole judged-property change is appending the diagnostic report's exact generalized clarification to the original rubric.
judgeMessages receives the same context and normalized decision shape as ordinary evaluation; expected_realization and expected_selection stay outside the judge payload.
Snapshot retains all fixtures, contexts, exact rubric strings, settings, command, script body, and runner/evaluator/manifest sources; fingerprint rejects dependency drift.
Every result retains the raw call request/response, original fixture, judged input/output, derived verdict and agreement; prior passing and failing records are both reused.
Resume validates fingerprint, condition, fixture, input, output, and exact provider request, then rederives checkedResult and agreement from raw text with the frozen expected label.
Both conditions require complete evaluable evidence. Original disagreements are diagnostics; clarified must agree on all eleven. Raw errors, missing or malformed verdicts in either condition block.
The script writes only its selected evidence directory; live target prompts, rubrics, cases and existing judgments are unchanged.

findings.problem: Initial summary counted only error status, permitting original-condition missing judgments to escape the error gate.
findings.resolution: Any raw.error or status outside pass/fail is counted as blocking in either condition. Memory probe with eleven original missing results and eleven clarified agreements exits 1.

findings.problem: Initial identity omitted shared runner/evaluator/manifest source dependencies, permitting changed implementation across resume.
findings.resolution: All three source bodies are pinned in identity. A changed runner body causes resume identity rejection before any mock call.

findings.problem: Initial resume trusted stored agrees and row metadata. A cached false verdict with agrees=true could yield a false 11/11 summary.
findings.resolution: Cached identity and exact request are validated; grade is rederived from raw.text and the frozen label. The original false-pass probe now reports 10/11 and exits 1.

findings.problem: Initial normalized decision omitted decision.mode compared with actual saved judge requests.
findings.resolution: Nested decision.mode is tutoring and was asserted in every synthetic call.

probes.error: Error: Cached calibration evidence does not match the frozen job.
Error: Cached calibration evidence does not match the frozen job.

probe_method.execution: Loaded the exact harness source in node:vm. Replaced only the filesystem with an in-memory evidence map and runner.call with a deterministic stub; used real shared judgeMessages, checkedResult, rubricsFor and sha. No real evidence file or model request was produced by the probes.
probe_method.valid_stub: Map response text plus declared instruction back to the frozen fixture; emit boolean expected_realization, numeric matching 0/1, and a nonempty reason under instruction_realization. Return the complete expected provider request.
probe_method.original_disagreement: Invert each original condition's expected_realization while keeping clarified correct; this remains a complete diagnostic comparison, so exit 0 is expected.
probe_method.missing_and_error: Original condition either returns error with no text, or error plus an otherwise valid verdict. Both must block despite clarified 11/11.
probe_method.malformed: Clarified condition returns non-JSON text; all eleven missing judgments must block.
probe_method.cached_flag: After a valid in-memory run, change clarified D-S1 raw verdict to false while leaving its stored result/agrees as a pass. Resume must recompute 10/11 and exit 1 with zero new calls.
probe_method.identity_checks: From a valid in-memory run, independently alter a cached fixture label, cached provider temperature, or runner source body. Each resume must reject with zero new calls.
probe_method.independent_assertions: Each fresh probe executes exactly 22 distinct condition/fixture jobs, retains three dependency sources, carries eleven fixtures, appends the exact clarification, includes nested mode, and excludes both expected-label fields from judge payloads.

limitations: Calibration deliberately makes one logical judge completion per fixture, with the shared transport retry policy. It does not add the production evaluator's possible format-only repair. Missing/malformed results block and remain preserved.
Nine passing deterministic probes establish harness behavior, not semantic judge agreement. The planned live calibration and subsequent full comparable affected-check rejudging remain separate work.
No current run score was modified, and the diagnostic proposal/calibration labels remain unchanged.

current_only_revision.scope: Optional literal-current-rubric calibration mode and default-mode regression; original source audit and live calibration evidence remain preserved.
changed_factors: Optional fourth argument --current-only selects one current condition with eleven frozen fixtures.
The current condition uses the exact string loaded by rubricsFor, preserving terminal newlines and applying no appended clarification.
currentOnly is part of snapshot identity, so a mode change cannot resume into an existing run.
The terminal agreement gate checks current in single-condition mode and clarified in default mode; errors in any executed condition remain blocking.
verified_fidelity: No fixture, context, expected label, provider setting, shared evaluator function, or raw evidence format changed.
Current mode performs exactly eleven distinct condition/fixture calls; default mode still performs twenty-two.
An already-clarified literal with a final newline remains byte-identical and contains the clarification exactly once.
A current disagreement yields 10/11 and exit 1; missing, malformed, or transport-error results also exit 1.
Cached forged agreement is recomputed from raw text; fixture/dependency/request checks from the original audit remain in the unchanged shared path.
Mode changes and unknown mode arguments are rejected before any judge call.
current_only_revision.probe_method: Node VM with an in-memory evidence filesystem and deterministic call stub, using real shared judgeMessages, checkedResult and sha. Literal-rubric output was supplied unchanged by the rubricsFor stub. Probes cover the actual current file text and an already-clarified string with a terminal newline; no live file or model was changed.

independently_verified_previous_live_cal.record_hash_encoding: SHA-256 of JSON.stringify(rows), where rows are {file,sha256} in original-then-clarified fixture order.

current_only_revision.calibration_interpretation: The previous run supports the draft clarified rubric string hashed 48c8ff3b91f9f2cedb1e5ffbf623242877f17ee0e2af2d16bf736099d9e0c9bd. Its 11/11 agreement does not establish calibration of subsequently adopted file bytes. The current-only mode enables that separate exact-text check after adoption.
current_only_revision.remaining_work: Adopt/version the evaluator only after current frozen runs finish, run current-only calibration against the exact adopted rubric file, then perform comparable affected-check rejudging. This audit does not alter prior run judgments.
